SELECT
    typeof(res.milliseconds) AS milliseconds_type,
    COUNT(*) AS winner_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT res.raceId) AS race_count,
    MIN(res.milliseconds) AS min_milliseconds,
    MAX(res.milliseconds) AS max_milliseconds,
    SUM(CASE WHEN res.time GLOB '[0-9]*:[0-9]*:[0-9]*' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS elapsed_text_rows,
    SUM(CASE WHEN res.positionOrder <> 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS different_order_rows
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975 AND res.position = 1
GROUP BY typeof(res.milliseconds)

item.text: Three races have two first-place records with identical elapsed times. The query will count each of those races once.

arguments.sql:
WITH race_winner_times AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.year, r.raceId, res.milliseconds
    FROM races AS r
    JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.position = 1
      AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    year,
    ((SUM(milliseconds) + 5 * COUNT(*)) / (10 * COUNT(*))) / 100.0
        AS mean_winner_elapsed_seconds
FROM race_winner_times
GROUP BY year
ORDER BY year
